variants.name: ApplicationTimeout
variants.summary: 504: Azion reached the application, but it did not answer in time. The Application hop reads Timed out; Try again and Go back.

variants.name: ApplicationError
variants.summary: 500: the application answered with an error while building the page. The Application hop reads Error; Try again and Go back.

variants.name: ApplicationUnavailable
variants.summary: 503: the application is down for maintenance or too busy. The Application hop reads Unavailable; the copy says the site usually comes back on its own.

variants.name: Blocked
variants.summary: 403: a firewall or WAF rule the site owner set on Azion matched the request, so it never reached the application. The Azion hop reads Blocked and the Application Not reached; Go to home page and Go back, and the advice is to contact the site owner with the request ID.

variants.name: RateLimited
variants.summary: 429: the visitor's connection sent more requests than the site allows. The Azion hop reads Rate limited and the Application Not reached; wait a minute, then Try again.

variants.name: NotFound
variants.summary: 404: the application has no page at the address. Every hop worked and the Application reads Not found; Go to home page and Go back.
